title: SO Game Events
tagline: An open-source Unity event system based on ScriptableObjects to decouple the objects in a scene.
overview: Objects communicate by raising and listening to event assets instead of holding direct references to each other, which reduces dependencies and keeps scenes modular.
Inspired by Ryan Hipple's talk [Game Architecture with Scriptable Objects](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=raQ3iHhE_Kk) (Unite Austin 2017). Usage is documented in the README.

highlights.title: Decoupled communication
highlights.text: Objects talk without knowing each other.

highlights.title: Easy to adopt
highlights.text: Drops into an existing Unity project.

highlights.title: Modular
highlights.text: Simple to extend to the needs of each project.

learnings: Event-driven architecture and low-dependency communication between game objects.
Designing reusable systems that fit into existing codebases.
